title: A two-stage Hurdle gradient-boosting framework for zero-inflated customer lifetime value prediction
description: Reproducible code for the two-stage Hurdle gradient-boosting framework for zero-inflated customer lifetime value (CLV) prediction. Stage 1 estimates purchase probability; Stage 2 predicts conditional spending on an arcsinh-transformed target; the final prediction applies Duan's smearing factor. Reproduces all tables and figures in the paper and its Supplementary Information using the UCI Online Retail II dataset.
